simple.summary: בׇּצְקַת (Botsqath) means Botscath , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: 2Kgs 22 1.

definitions.full: H1218. Botsqath בָּצְקַת proper name, of a location (? compare Arabic an elevated region covered with volcanic stones) city of Judah toward Philistines, בָּצְקַת Josh 15:39 ; בָּצְקַת֑ 2Kin 22:1 (home of Josiah's mother).
